title: THE CRIER MARKS THE PLAYER IT SAW
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08. In co-op a Crier that spotted player 2 told the host "A crier has you" and, when it fired, flashed MARKED on the host, who was never seen. Player 2, the one actually marked, got no line, no CRIER countdown and no banner, so the counterplay (kill it or move before it fires) was invisible to him. THE OVERSEER noticing player 2 was also said to the host. Now each warning goes to the player it is about, and every window draws the Crier countdown.
now: In co-op, a Crier that spots player 2 warns player 2, shows him its countdown, and marks him, not the host.
